_comment: Canonical named points + areas on the CTF arena (1235x659, mirror line x=617). Shared language: humans use the names in discussion; beacon imports them for strategy targets (mapdata.poi). Points curated by James 2026-07-27. Areas are rotated rects: cx/cy center, w/h size, angle degrees CCW. Edit with tools/poi_editor.html.
